title: The Generalized Friendship Paradox for Eigenvectors
summary: In this paper, we investigate the generalized friendship paradox for eigenvectors (alternatively called the eigen friendship paradox and abbreviated hereafter as EFP) in the setting of inhomogeneous Erdős--Rényi random graphs whose edge probabilities are generated by a continuous graphon. We consider the adjacency matrix of the graph and take the entries of the eigenvector corresponding to its largest eigenvalue as the vertex attributes.
